## Claims
- [source-backed] The catalog abstract for St. Dizier–Yong, *Presenting the cohomology of a Schubert variety: Proof of the minimality conjecture* (2024), says: “We prove the minimality conjecture.” [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832]
- [unsupported] No supplied full-text passage gives the 2024 theorem number, exact statement, coefficient ring, hypotheses, or a statement about \(J/\Lambda_+J\).
- [unsupported] The abstract is silent on the stronger assertion \(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}/\Lambda_+J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}\); therefore it cannot establish or refute that assertion.

## Strategy
Compared the supplied 2024 metadata/abstract with the required theorem-level certificate. No FULL-TEXT SOURCE block for the 2024 paper was supplied.

## Gaps
The requested bounded exact full-text passages with stable theorem and hypothesis locators were not obtained. Consequently, independent theorem-level review is impossible.

**Requested target established: no.** The available evidence supports only an abstract-level claim of minimality, not the stronger indecomposables statement.

## Next
Provide numbered full-text passages from the 2024 paper containing its minimality theorem, hypotheses, and any quotient/indecomposables result.
